closureStatement: Samsung NX60 gas R1 evidence fits the frozen electric_range rev1 contract without canonical expansion, divergence, or gas-side ontology. Bake/broil instance-scope abstraction survives radical implementation change (relay→element vs relay→HSI→valve→burner). Gas hardware remains platform overlay vocabulary. electric_range.json is unchanged. Organizational rename (electric_range → range_oven) and gas_range template routing remain separate human gates — not authorized by this closure.

governanceConclusion.statement: CG-11 demonstrates functional compatibility of the frozen electric-range ontology with a gas-range implementation. It does not establish that every gas-specific implementation detail belongs in the canonical ontology, nor does it authorize renaming the ontology.
